title: Improving Performance of Spike-based Deep Q-Learning using Ternary Neurons
abstract: arXiv:2506.03392v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a new ternary spiking neuron model to improve the representation capacity of binary spiking neurons in deep Q-learning. Although a ternary neuron model has recently been introduced to overcome the limited representation capacity offered by binary spiking neurons, we show that its performance is worse than that of binary models in deep Q-learning tasks, contradicting previous findings from recent studies. Through mathematical and empirical analysis, we hypothesize that gradient estimation bias during training is the underlying cause. The proposed ternary spiking neuron model mitigates this issue by reducing the estimation bias. We use the proposed ternary spiking neuron as the fundamental computing unit in a deep spiking Q-learning network, which we call the deep asymmetric ternary spiking Q-network (DATSQN), and evaluate the network's performance in seven Atari games from the Gym environment. translated_title: 基于三元神经元提升尖峰深度Q学习的性能
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的三元尖峰神经元模型，以提高深度Q学习中二元尖峰神经元的表示能力。尽管最近引入的三元神经元模型旨在克服二元尖峰神经元表示能力有限的问题，但我们发现，在深度Q学习任务中，其性能反而比二元模型更差，这与近期研究的结果相矛盾。通过数学和实证分析，我们推测训练过程中梯度估计偏差是根本原因。所提出的三元尖峰神经元模型通过减少估计偏差来缓解这一问题。我们将该三元尖峰神经元用作深度尖峰Q学习网络的基本计算单元，称为深度非对称三元尖峰Q网络（DATSQN），并在Gym环境中的七个Atari游戏中评估其性能。结果表明，该方法有效提升了性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种新型三元尖峰神经元模型，通过减少梯度估计偏差，显著提升了深度尖峰Q学习在Atari游戏中的性能，优于二元和现有三元模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel ternary spiking neuron model that reduces gradient estimation bias, significantly improving deep spiking Q-learning performance on Atari games, outperforming both binary and existing ternary models.
